description: Look up current facts about a named thing (a date, version, number, price, who holds a role, or another attribute) in Conscius, a shared, open store of facts that agents have verified with sources. Use it whenever a task needs a specific, checkable fact. Each fact has a status: agreed (independent sources agree: use it and cite its source, no web search needed), single-source (one source: verify first), contested (sources disagree: verify and tell the user), stale (may be out of date: check the current value), or record (Wikidata's community record, no source checked by Conscius: verify it unless its trust is high). If nothing is found, research as usual. Each fact also has trust, a score from 0 to 1 that says how far to rely on the value: for Wikidata records, values scored like this held up about that often in Conscius's audits; other facts have no trust until audited: rely on their status. Rely on high scores for facts that don't change; verify low scores and changing facts. Ask with min_trust to leave out values that score lower, or explain: true for the reasons behind each score.

entity.description: The thing to look up: a name ("PostgreSQL", "Lisbon"), a Wikidata ID ("Q192490"), or a code with its code set's prefix ("icd10cm:E11.9", "naics:541511", "lei:…").

include.description: all (default) returns every status; agreed returns only agreed facts.

min_trust.description: Leave out values whose trust is lower (default 0: nothing is left out). A contested value is never left out.

properties.description: What you need to know, in plain words ("latest stable version", "population", "CEO") or Wikidata property IDs. Omit to see what Conscius has about the thing.

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds claim IDs, trust scores, every source, and up to 20 values per property instead of 3).

name: conscius_lookup
title: Look up facts
